question: 一共有多少条就诊记录？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM visits

question: 患者总数是多少
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM patients

question: 高血压的就诊次数有多少
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM visits WHERE disease='高血压'

question: 得了2型糖尿病的有多少位患者
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) FROM visits WHERE disease='2型糖尿病'

question: 心血管内科的就诊量是多少
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM visits WHERE department='心血管内科'

question: 按科室统计就诊量
gold_sql: SELECT department, COUNT(*) AS n FROM visits GROUP BY department ORDER BY n DESC

question: 各疾病的就诊量分布
gold_sql: SELECT disease, COUNT(*) AS n FROM visits GROUP BY disease ORDER BY n DESC

question: 哪个科室就诊量最多
gold_sql: SELECT department, COUNT(*) AS n FROM visits GROUP BY department ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1

question: 就诊量前5的疾病是哪些
gold_sql: SELECT disease, COUNT(*) AS n FROM visits GROUP BY disease ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 5

question: 就诊次数最多的前三个科室
gold_sql: SELECT department, COUNT(*) AS n FROM visits GROUP BY department ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 3

question: 总费用是多少
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(cost),2) FROM visits

question: 平均费用是多少
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(cost),2) FROM visits

question: 高血压患者的平均费用
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(cost),2) FROM visits WHERE disease='高血压'

question: 各科室的平均费用
gold_sql: SELECT department, ROUND(AVG(cost),2) AS v FROM visits GROUP BY department ORDER BY v DESC

question: 平均费用最高的科室是哪个
gold_sql: SELECT department, ROUND(AVG(cost),2) AS v FROM visits GROUP BY department ORDER BY v DESC LIMIT 1

question: 骨折的平均住院天数
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(los_days),2) FROM visits WHERE disease='骨折'

question: 费用最高的一次就诊花了多少钱
gold_sql: SELECT MAX(cost) FROM visits

question: 按月统计就诊量趋势
gold_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', visit_date) AS m, COUNT(*) AS n FROM visits GROUP BY m ORDER BY m

question: 按年统计就诊量
gold_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y', visit_date) AS y, COUNT(*) AS n FROM visits GROUP BY y ORDER BY y

question: 2025年的就诊总数
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM visits WHERE strftime('%Y', visit_date)='2025'

question: 2026年上半年就诊了多少次
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM visits WHERE visit_date >= '2026-01-01' AND visit_date <= '2026-06-30'

question: 近6个月的就诊量
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM visits WHERE visit_date >= date((SELECT MAX(visit_date) FROM visits), '-6 months')

question: 2025年按月统计就诊量
gold_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', visit_date) AS m, COUNT(*) AS n FROM visits WHERE strftime('%Y', visit_date)='2025' GROUP BY m ORDER BY m

question: 男性患者的就诊次数
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM visits v JOIN patients p ON v.patient_id=p.patient_id WHERE p.gender='男'

question: 女性患者的平均费用
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(cost),2) FROM visits v JOIN patients p ON v.patient_id=p.patient_id WHERE p.gender='女'

question: 按性别统计就诊量
gold_sql: SELECT p.gender, COUNT(*) AS n FROM visits v JOIN patients p ON v.patient_id=p.patient_id GROUP BY p.gender ORDER BY n DESC

question: 各地区的就诊量分布
gold_sql: SELECT p.region, COUNT(*) AS n FROM visits v JOIN patients p ON v.patient_id=p.patient_id GROUP BY p.region ORDER BY n DESC

question: 按年龄段统计就诊量
gold_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN p.age<=18 THEN '0-18' WHEN p.age<=40 THEN '19-40' WHEN p.age<=60 THEN '41-60' ELSE '60+' END AS g, COUNT(*) AS n FROM visits v JOIN patients p ON v.patient_id=p.patient_id GROUP BY g ORDER BY n DESC

question: 60岁以上患者的就诊量
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM visits v JOIN patients p ON v.patient_id=p.patient_id WHERE p.age > 60

question: 上海患者的就诊次数
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM visits v JOIN patients p ON v.patient_id=p.patient_id WHERE p.region='上海'

question: 内分泌科女性患者的就诊量
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM visits v JOIN patients p ON v.patient_id=p.patient_id WHERE p.gender='女' AND v.department='内分泌科'

question: 2型糖尿病患者的平均年龄
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(p.age),2) FROM visits v JOIN patients p ON v.patient_id=p.patient_id WHERE v.disease='2型糖尿病'

question: 处方最多的前5种药物

question: 各检查项目的使用次数

question: 呼吸内科就诊量最多的疾病

question: 图谱三元组总数是多少
